condition: When the host timezone currently has a +00:00 offset (e.g. Europe/London in winter, Europe/Lisbon), the utc plugin's valueOf treats $localOffset 0 as missing because it uses ||. It then falls back to getTimezoneOffset(), so dayjs.tz(...) and utcOffset(...) return timestamps that are off by an hour.
workaround: Patch the utc plugin's valueOf to use a null/undefined check (??) instead of || on $x.$localOffset, as in PR #1678. Otherwise, run the process with TZ=UTC.
